blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Single deployment on Ethereum (100% of circulating supply: 2,604,641.380283959 tBRL at finalized block 26505955, hash 0xa50e54c6703eaed980d65280d5d8eb0d0bda24f104ed8f48d94814aafedd0767, 2026-11-27T10:30:47Z). Verified Blockscout source and pinned bytecode reads confirm AssetToken (0x4c1b46adb8877e389171ec6ef67b385094c0afad, 6,176 bytes, Solidity 0.8.30, zero EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots) is an immutable OpenZeppelin ERC20Permit + Ownable2Step token with only setMinter, mint, burn, burnFrom (allowance-gated), and setNotice; it has no transfer blacklist, address freeze, global transfer pause, or arbitrary-holder burn. Although Tenbin's Terms of Use mention wallet blacklisting and Controller (0x0ef47cc8e244dbc8628fdeffd4ee4dd747d14081) exposes setIsRestricted(address,bool) under RESTRICTER_ROLE (held by the 3-of-5 Admin Safe 0xe6eb534f33a635e8d867414af32f766d221f30d1), that restriction gates only KYC primary mint/redeem and staking flows rather than secondary ERC-20 transfers. The inherited verdict follows the FreezeWatch reserve test: pinned on-chain USDC alone (355,144.70 USDC in the Steakhouse Morpho V2 vault, ~77.0% of tBRL liability value) strictly exceeds the >50% threshold in issuer-freezable Circle USDC (usdc-circle) even under the worst-case denominator attributing 100% of Tenbin's entire $291,208.36 cross-product off-chain Chainlink PoR balance to tBRL (355,144.70 / (355,144.70 + 291,208.36) = 54.95% > 50%), while exact whole-book reserve weights remain withheld.

oracleRisk.summary: tBRL does not price mint or redemption orders directly from an on-chain oracle; off-chain signed orders are checked against an on-chain Chainlink BRL/USD price feed backstop (0x3126e7f38d5f60f4e2b6ec3511c7bdbd79317df1 via OracleAdapter 0xdfd57c54f970910dccc843d37ee0b84e45b62a06) with an 8% Controller deviation tolerance.

branchApplicability.rationale: Tenbin operates a single Controller mint/redeem path with an on-chain Chainlink BRL/USD sanity backstop (8% tolerance at block 26505955) and off-chain CME futures hedging. Holders do not open borrower-specific collateralized debt positions or liquidation branches.
